prior_knowledge: Published aggregate outcomes, selected development CV scores, profiles and predictor equations have been read. This is not prospective confirmation.
units: All 1152 existing generations, 96 question blocks, separate A/B measurement branches. Original predictions and labels remain unchanged.
diagnostics: Development versus evaluation D rates at global, evidence, setting and 24 joint-cell levels; all cells reported.

Exact binary Brier increment = prediction-change squared minus twice prediction-change times prior residual. Split Joint-minus-Setting into balanced-design evidence-main and interaction components. No parameter fitting.
Compare development CV ordering with evaluation ordering; do not attribute differences uniquely to finite sampling, model runtime, questions or raters.
Report all six-code agreement, derived category and strict-event agreement, and mode/category distributions; agreement is not semantic truth.
Exact common-D sensitivity envelope on the 28 A/B-discordant outputs only, keeping agreed labels fixed. No adjudication or relabeling. Apply to all five prespecified contrasts.
Question leave-one-out and removal of the three length-stop cases as explicitly secondary sensitivity descriptions; primary score unchanged.
Read every D-disagreement case with full question/completion and both original codes/notes to describe interpretation boundaries; do not produce corrected labels.
excluded: No predictor refit or new shrinkage selection
No significance or population interval claim
No historical score, label or archive changes
next_use: Hypothesis generation and measurement/design choices for a separate future protocol.
